model: pinned pilot.operator(n,True), pilot.inputs train/test, regional g; reference only in verification

cases.smooth: A0 + 0.25*(j/11)^2 times a full-grid Dirichlet diffusion with coefficient 0.6+0.4*x at each face midpoint
cases.jump: A0 plus four fixed positive internal horizontal face increments with amplitudes a=[0,0,0,0,6,6,6,6,0,12,12,12], weights [1,1/2,3/4,1/4]; nodes floor((.26,.47),(.31,.53),(.68,.47),(.73,.53))*n, face from (i,j) to (i+1,j)

rhs: held-out manufactured fields from pinned test sequence; multiply by actual operator; four pilot training fields are disjoint calibration diagnostics
interval4: factorize at frames 0,4,8; start old-factor direct solve and preconditioned CG as necessary, rtol=1e-8, then check true residual
trigger: cached LU x0 and cached adjoint z; check true residual and goal bound. On failure use updated actual low-rank correction for jump, otherwise refactor actual matrix and recompute adjoint; after correction recheck both, fall back to rebuild if necessary
dst: calibrate loosest candidate on fixed training fields with actual errors; same threshold for cold and warm, no held-out outcome fed to either; tolerances 1e-3,3e-4,1e-4,3e-5,1e-5,1e-6,1e-7
practical_win: all heldout frames pass and median total time <= 0.8 times fastest other method that passes all frames of that size and regime
scope: SciPy CPU, ordinary float64, no outward rounding; common verified snapshots separately timed; distinct stage timers and each shuffled repetition published; cumulative process RSS only
